name: Neon

free_tier.notes: Autoscaling up to 2 CU (8 GB RAM max); compute suspends when the monthly allowance is exhausted until the next billing month
Managed Better Auth (formerly listed as Neon Auth): 'On the Free plan, Managed Better Auth is included for up to 60,000 MAU.'

notes: Perpetual free tier, not a trial; no credit card required. If the monthly 100 CU-hour compute allowance is reached, compute is suspended until the next billing month (upgrade resumes immediately). Free-plan computes also auto-suspend (scale to zero) when idle. Limits are per-project on compute/storage but capped at 100 projects. 2026-08-15: 'Neon Auth' is now listed as 'Managed Better Auth' (60,000 MAU on Free unchanged).
